responsibility: This target mode-definition file registers the extra vector machine modes used by the NDS32 backend, namely the packed integer vector sizes that underpin DSP and intrinsic support. By declaring the 4-byte and 8-byte integer vector mode sets, it enables GCC to create the V4QI, V2HI, V8QI, V4HI, and V2SI modes that neighboring DSP patterns, predicates, and builtin interfaces depend on.
